changelog.summary: Add an administrator-only notification proof that uses NAD core-owned channels while preserving existing System Monitor configuration and surfaces.
entries: Add the notifications.emit capability with a single explicit test action.
Route the test event through the NAD Host API instead of adding notification provider settings to the Module.
Preserve the Module ID, slug, config keys, view permission, Page path, and Widget IDs for restart-free update.

preserves: permission action view; adds administrator action notify
